notes.note: Bounded hosted-gate repair review at7ada488961: inspected all reported source deltas. Marketplace source management now has explicit access:manage credential scope in addition to unchanged operatorOnly principal authorization; API/SDK/plugin prose reflects this separation, without granting clients host filesystem/network authority. Installed experience inventory deliberately inherits existing Station Skills read exposure; this does not assert request-principal projection or fix unrelated Skills visibility. Immutable Session experience reads retain requested/current/historical thread authorization before and after awaits. The real frame runtime constructor now encodes HTML delimiters and JS line separators while preserving identity; bridge origin/window/source/grant controls and opaque sandbox remain, with21 owner cases and intended unescaped-script mutation failure/restoration. The old CodeQL exception is removed rather than broadened; hosted CodeQL remains pending. Registry lifecycle fixture changes only a public identity label; historical noncredential fingerprint has owner/independent attestation and positive/negative scanner controls in#3176. Static pin discovery now recognizes Node URL value-import aliases while preserving Vite-safe fixture loaders and rejecting other/type-only/commented constructors;356 keepers and9 intended injected failures protect scope and selection. CSS border references use declared design tokens; prior browser/native/release limits remain. These are narrow changed-input reviews, not revalidation of every old claim or a publication/native-rich completion receipt.
